KNOW #3 📚 Leverage Aur Margin
$100 se $10,000 ki trade kaise khul jaati hai?
• Broker aapko leverage deta hai, yaani udhaar ki buying power.
• 1:100 leverage pe $10,000 ki trade ke liye sirf $100 margin lock hota hai.
• Lekin profit aur loss poore $10,000 pe chalta hai.
Tip: leverage tez gaadi hai. Brake hai stop loss.
Aur seekhna hai to follow karo. Trade setups ke liye Telegram join karo — link bio me 🕷️
